verification_scope: Frozen identity, checkpoint hashes, 218 IDs and metric means checked. Independently recomputed nine fields on all twelve saved second-seed best/final raw arrays: maximum difference zero. First-seed review already checked its twelve arrays. No fresh complete 218-image inference.
endpoint_selection: Post hoc diagnostic prompted by the observed second-seed endpoint F1 decline. Reuses the same six predefined validation IDs, now at seed 320113. No training change, checkpoint reselection, or cherry-picked replacement images.

endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0005: Best-to-final AbsRel 0.068695 to 0.074942, F1 0.335072 to 0.272181. Upper-wall and table errors brighten; matched table-back fragments disappear and chair edges shift. Whiteboard boundary remains missed in both.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0598: AbsRel improves 0.044123 to 0.041666 and F1 improves 0.408938 to 0.438349. Some tabletop/right-edge matches recover, although fine legs and sofa boundaries remain missed and F1 stays below B0 0.537. Retained counterexample to uniform degradation.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_1440: AbsRel worsens 0.103360 to 0.113633; F1 0.503580 to 0.492561. Counter surface error increases, chair slats retain broad high error and some small matched fragments are lost. Large outlines remain present.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0226: AbsRel improves 0.176322 to 0.163751 while F1 worsens 0.459998 to 0.453252. Person/floor errors decrease in places, but foreground seat error increases and branches/furniture remain misaligned. Value improvement does not imply boundary recovery.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0246: AbsRel worsens 0.197091 to 0.201745, both much worse than B0 0.1129. Broad wall/floor and foreground-object errors remain. F1 slightly improves 0.494928 to 0.505549 with modest outline changes; thin stand stays missed.
endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0080: AbsRel improves 0.082325 to 0.076858, while F1 falls 0.060597 to exactly 0. The tiny upper shelf-edge fragments at best vanish at final. Independently checked prediction-edge count is 26 to 0, matched GT 51 to 0, fixed GT 1628. This is zero detected depth discontinuities under the predefined metric threshold, not zero depth values or an all-black raw prediction.

plot_observations: Both J400 runs rapidly reduce validation error and attain their raw best at 2200 and 1400; they stop at 3200 and 2400. Second-seed validation rebounds while online training loss continues downward. Its final degradation is 3.7483% and predefined late-loss/validation indicator is true.
Neither run meets the required terminal 500-step band within 1% of its own best. Both confirm <=0.10 at 300; neither has three consecutive <=0.09 evaluations. A sub-0.09 best is insufficient.
Sample-efficiency plots label J400 n=2 and R/L400 n=3. These descriptive group lines are not matched pair estimates; infer differences from the same-seed paired statistics instead.

The updated stopping plot shows lower J400 endpoint F1 than the original-model line and greater endpoint variation, driven mainly by seed 320113. A missing stable-subset point is not a zero metric or successful convergence.

The second-seed fixed panels show localized and widespread misses, with improvements in 0598 and in some depth-value metrics. Do not summarize all images as degrading or attribute this solely to one module without an intervention.
conclusions: J400 versus matched J200: both seeds improve all five best metric means. AbsRel difference -0.00280599 has scene CI [-0.00604035,0.00028693], now including zero; this supersedes the stronger first-seed interval. F1 increases 0.00547138 with CI [0.00139813,0.00922425]. Other metric intervals include zero. Still only two seeds.

J400 versus matched L400: AbsRel -0.000114406, CI [-0.00241787,0.00210272], with one seed better and one worse. No established overall-accuracy advantage. Boundary F1 declines in both seeds by mean 0.0114644, CI [-0.0189111,-0.00487562]; delta1 also declines with its interval just below zero. Boundary-band AbsRel improves in both by 0.00624904, CI [-0.00949877,-0.00350451]. This is a boundary-value versus edge-detection tradeoff.

J400 versus matched R400: RMSE and boundary-band error favor J with conditional intervals excluding zero; AbsRel, delta1 and F1 intervals include zero. Compared with B0, four depth-value metrics improve with intervals excluding zero, while F1 mean difference 0.00123121 has CI [-0.00785120,0.01013823]. No established F1 gain over original.

Best-to-final AbsRel degrades 0.4152% and 3.7483%. Both F1 means decline, especially seed 320113 (0.446399 to 0.411915). In that seed, 169/218 image F1 values worsen, 43 improve and 6 tie; predicted edges 435033 to 392579 while GT edges remain 769528. This supports real boundary loss under the fixed diagnostic, not a changed GT denominator.

The group final-versus-best F1 difference is -0.0181140 with scene CI [-0.0229978,-0.0136873]; AbsRel deterioration also excludes zero. These are descriptive comparisons to a validation-selected best, not unbiased checkpoint comparisons or an alternative selection rule.

Mean recorded total time 1844.41 +/- 385.81 s includes training/validation/detailed scoring; no isolated hardware benchmarking. 100817 trainable parameters, peak allocated 4166.52 MiB. Attempts/successful updates/skips are 3200/3198/2 and 2400/2397/3. No batch/config changes or failures in these two runs.
Continue the third J400 seed and all remaining stages unchanged. Do not select a winner from two seeds or alter training because endpoint degradation was observed. No new test evaluation has begun.
limits: Two training seeds are not final evidence; reported SD is across these two only. Scene bootstrap uses 62 clusters, 2000 replicates and seed 320119, preserving image weights; intervals are conditional on available seeds, descriptive, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Validation has been used for selection; test has historical exposure. Endpoint images show outcomes, not their causal mechanism or exact onset.
